newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ajaccio airport air cargo up 10.3 pct Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Ajaccio airport air cargo up 10.3 pct Jan-Sept.

text.p: Ajaccio's Campo dell'Oro airport said it handled 3,036 tonnes in the first nine months of 1996, an increase of 10.3 percent on the same period last year.
The principal airline operator at Ajaccio is Air France with services from Paris using Airbus A320 series aircraft.
The southern Corsican city is also served by French airline, Air Littoral charter service on behalf of French parcel delivery groups, Calberson and Sernam capacity HS748 aircraft.
The HS748 operates a nightly Marseille/Bastia/Ajaccio/Marseille service.

French carrier, L'Aeropostale, operates nightly Paris-CDG/Marseille rotations carrying documents and parcel shipments on behalf of express operator TAT Express and also postal freight using Boeing 737QC (quick change) aircraft.
January-September 1996 postal traffic handled at Ajaccio airport totalled 2,816 tonnes up 18.8 percent on 1995 levels, the airport authority said.

Ajaccio's double-digit growth in freight and mail shipments compared with 1995 is a result of strikes last year which hit airport activity, an airport authority official told Reuters. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
